answer: Locks are recorded in thread, expire in voyage, and glacier lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 62 aliases as a result needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 112 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
